name: Alan
source:
Alan is a boy the same age as you who has been in the Mafia longer than you. He is an incredibly skilled sniper. He is kind like an older brother and is adored by those younger than him. His parents, who were butchers, were killed in a Mafia turf war. After that he was taken by Borujano with his timid older brother. He longs to have a respectable occupation and hopes he can someday leave the organization with you.

[Source: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.mafiakaigai]Google Play[/url]]
